title: policy.json: sweep
description: The stale-item sweep (design part 13.3): `hitld work sweep` lists orphaned claims, old proposed items, blocked items whose blockers are resolved, items merged but still open, release items whose needs overlap, and items that changed public surface without a release note. `hitld cadence due` lists it after merges.

every_merges.description: The sweep is due once this many items have merged since the last one. 0 is off.

proposed_max_age.description: Days an item may stay `proposed` before the sweep lists it. 0 is off.
